issue.title: Autograph is incompatible with typeguard
issue.body:
Hello, it's surely not the job of typeguard to change anything to be compatible, I'm just leaving the issue here in case somebody were to have the same issue and was looking for the reason.

The original issue is in the tensorflow repository: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/36462

And thanks for this awesome tool!

issue.title: Complete typing

repository.name: addons
repository.description: Useful extra functionality for TensorFlow 2.x maintained by SIG-addons

issue.body:
Since python2 support was dropped we've begun typing TFA. 

To do this gracefully we excluded several modules which were under active development so as to minimize impact on active PRs. We need to remove those modules from the exclusion list as they become no longer worked on and type them appropriately.

Exclusion list:
https://github.com/tensorflow/addons/blob/master/tools/ci_build/verify/check_typing_info.py#L27-L135
